title: Can You Afford a $1,200 Car Payment? The Truth

scenes.text: A $1,200 monthly car payment looks affordable on a $5,000 salary.
Car payments that fit 15% of your income are safe.
scenes.label: 15% Car Rule

scenes.text: The 15% rule applies to total debt, not just car payments. A $1,200 payment on a $5,000 salary exceeds 20% of income, leaving little room for emergencies or savings.
scenes.label: Debt Ratio Matters

scenes.text: Balance your budget: keep all debt below 30% of income.
scenes.label: Debt Balance

scenes.text: Follow and your future rich self will thank you.

description: A $1,200 car payment might look doable, but is it really? Learn how debt ratios affect your financial health and stay on track. Follow for more money truths!
